# botyard_bot_schedules (Data Source)

Lists every recurring schedule on a Botyard bot, including schedules the bot created itself. Use it to find a schedule's ID for `terraform import botyard_bot_schedule.<name> <bot_slug>/<id>`, or to read `next_fire_at`, which `botyard_bot_schedule` does not store.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Every recurring schedule on a bot, including ones the bot created itself and
# ones no Terraform configuration manages.
data "botyard_bot_schedules" "assistant" {
  bot_slug = "my-assistant"
}

output "next_runs" {
  value = {
    for s in data.botyard_bot_schedules.assistant.schedules :
    coalesce(s.title, s.id) => s.next_fire_at if s.enabled
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `bot_slug` (String) Slug of the bot whose schedules to list.

### Read-Only

- `schedules` (Attributes List) The bot's recurring schedules, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--schedules))

<a id="nestedatt--schedules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `schedules`

Read-Only:

- `action_kind` (String) `prompt` or `command`.
- `catchup_policy` (String) `skip` or `run_once_on_recovery`.
- `command` (Attributes) Set when `action_kind` is `command`. The command's run policy (exit codes, window, routing, env) is not listed here; import the schedule to manage it. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--schedules--command))
- `conversation_id` (String) Conversation the schedule wakes into.
- `created_at` (String) Creation time (RFC 3339).
- `cron` (Attributes) Set when `spec_kind` is `cron`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--schedules--cron))
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the schedule fires. False when paused, including an auto-pause.
- `id` (String) The schedule ID.
- `interval` (Attributes) Set when `spec_kind` is `interval`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--schedules--interval))
- `max_consecutive_failures` (Number) Auto-pause threshold; `0` never auto-pauses.
- `next_fire_at` (String) Next occurrence (RFC 3339), derived on every read. Null when paused or when no occurrence remains.
- `prompt` (String) Wake message, when `action_kind` is `prompt`.
- `rrule` (Attributes) Set when `spec_kind` is `rrule`. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--schedules--rrule))
- `skip_if_busy` (Boolean) Whether a fire is skipped while the conversation is busy.
- `spec_kind` (String) Timing kind: `cron`, `interval` or `rrule`. A kind this provider version does not know (such as `event`) is reported here, with `cron`, `interval` and `rrule` all null.
- `timezone` (String) IANA timezone the schedule fires in.
- `title` (String) Human-friendly label, or null.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update time (RFC 3339).

<a id="nestedatt--schedules--command"></a>
### Nested Schema for `schedules.command`

Read-Only:

- `command` (String) Shell command.
- `concurrency_group` (String) Lock shared across the bot's command schedules, or null.
- `cwd` (String) Working directory relative to the workspace root, or null.
- `log_path` (String) Absolute log path, or null.
- `output_path` (String) Absolute output path, or null.
- `overlap_policy` (String) `skip` or `queue`.
- `timeout_seconds` (Number) Deadline per attempt, or null.


<a id="nestedatt--schedules--cron"></a>
### Nested Schema for `schedules.cron`

Read-Only:

- `cron` (String) Cron expression.


<a id="nestedatt--schedules--interval"></a>
### Nested Schema for `schedules.interval`

Read-Only:

- `anchor` (String) RFC 3339 phase anchor, or null for the Unix epoch.
- `interval_seconds` (Number) Period between fires, in seconds.


<a id="nestedatt--schedules--rrule"></a>
### Nested Schema for `schedules.rrule`

Read-Only:

- `rrule` (String) RFC 5545 recurrence rule.
